integrity: The universal criterion is derived symbolically and a rational instability witness is checked with exact arithmetic. Literature searches did not establish global priority; older or inaccessible specialized derivations remain a residual risk.
scientific_limitations: Exact Schur stability criterion for the two-period sample map of the double integrator under fixed positive proportional-derivative gains and zero-order hold. It does not cover arbitrary aperiodic sequences, actuator saturation, delay, noise, nonlinear dynamics, or gain perturbations.
title: Exact period-two sampling stability boundary for a sampled double integrator
